title: Evaluating the Clinical Safety of LLMs in Response to High-Risk Mental Health Disclosures
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are related to the clinical safety of LLMs in mental health contexts, not religion or faith. The key finding is that no current general-purpose LLM can be considered clinically safe by default, with Claude performing best on a composite safety metric, while models like ChatGPT, Grok 3, and LLAMA underperformed.
